issues.description: Post-rebase mix letflow.lint_handoffs fails with 9 new un-grandfathered violations, all under handoffs/WF03-ISS0260-20260822/: 7x [H6] non-JSON handoff-shaped .md files (step-02-code-designer.md, step-02b-code-design-validator.md, step-02c-code-design-validator-recheck.md, step-02d-code-design-validator-final.md, step-03-elixir-dev.md, step-03b-security-reviewer.md, step-03c-reviewer.md) plus [H1] missing status + [H3] non-schema top-level keys in step-04d-test-design-validator-recheck.json. All introduced by commit dff2270 (PR #515, run WF03-ISS0260-20260822 -- a separate, already-merged run), landed on main after this branch's grandfather list was last extended in step-07-elixir-dev-rework.json. Root cause is structural: @grandfathered has no wildcard/prefix matching, so it can only ever catch up to main's history at the moment it's last edited -- any run merging handoff-shaped .md files (or malformed .json handoffs) between that edit and this branch's next rebase attempt will trip it again. This is the SAME class of issue as h6-violations-wf03-iss0261-handoffs (previous FAIL), now recurring with a 3rd unrelated run (WF03-ISS0260-20260822) and 2 additional rule IDs (H1, H3) beyond H6. ORCH should consider, alongside the file-by-file grandfather extension: (a) whether @grandfathered needs a run-id-prefix or path-glob form instead of exact-file entries to stop this recurring every rebase, or (b) whether merging this branch should be re-sequenced/paused until no other in-flight run is landing handoff-shaped non-JSON files, since the two are structurally racing. Not decided unilaterally here -- needs ISSUE-FIXER/REVIEWER routing.
